metadata.content:
*The longer it cooks, the bigger the boom.*

| **Area, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)**        |             **[Free maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/free-maneuver)** |
|-------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 2 [cube](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/cube) within 10** | **🎯 Each enemy in the area** |

**Effect:** Each target takes acid, fire, or poison damage (your choice) equal to your [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility) score.

For each [combat round](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/combat-round) that has passed since this ability was last used in the current encounter, the area increases by 1 and you gain 1 [surge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge) that must be used with this ability. After using the ability or at the end of the encounter, its area and [surges](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge) are reset.

**Spend 2+ Insight:** For every 2 insight spent, you increase the [cube](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/cube)'s [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) by 1 and gain 1 [surge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge) that can be used only with this ability.
